input.raw_content: Maintainer reversal (2026-10-29T21:38:17+00:00). Reverses decision error-response-shape. Old choice: HTTP errors return the JSON body {"errors": [detail]} with the status code of the exception (app/app/api/errors/http_error.py). New decision error-response-shape-v2: Error responses return RFC 7807 application/problem+json with the fields type, title, status and detail. Reason: The public API is moving to a standard error format so client libraries can parse errors without custom code. (Invented for this demo.) Scope: Decision only. The code under app/ is not changed.
